propositions: Janitor discovery process does not ask whether test assertions can fail when contracts are violated, leaving oracle-strength and contract-coverage gaps undetected
The existing antipattern rubric at code-review-tests.md is run only on diffs, not on the resting tree, creating a reach gap for concern #12 across the codebase
The hardcoded 'eleven concerns' at discovery.md:152 can drift from the actual numbered concern list without detection, exemplifying the drift-oracle failure concern #12 names

A schema field 'antipattern_id' must distinguish three new oracle antipattern classes—fixture-mutates-foreign-state, mismatched-hardening-equivalence, unstated-policy-oracle—absent from code-review-tests.md
Test-only findings are incorrectly anchored to prod_impact=none by file path rather than by the production contract they guard, causing critical contract violations to be misclassified as harmless

The portable fallback in references/patterns.md must provide oracle-strength question, escape_input proof requirement, false-positive floor, antipattern ids, and runnable query so concern #12 works on non-rebar repos
